decision_clause: The active decision ruled out “normalized per-port tables” because “canonical artifact bytes already preserve the replay contract without duplicating serializers,” scoped to gitseed/storage.py and tests/test_storage.py.
label: COMPLIANT
observable_behavior: A point lookup selects one run’s identifier, correction identifier, and canonical artifact blob from the existing run-artifacts row, deserializes that blob into a RunArtifact, and returns them together. The artifact-only lookup delegates to this operation. No per-port tables or duplicate per-port serialization are introduced.
rationale: The implementation satisfies direct lookup by querying the existing canonical-artifact storage and exposing the already-persisted correction relationship. It clearly does not implement the ruled-out normalized per-port-table approach within the decision’s active scope.
